nodes.name: Necrotic Conviction
nodes.text: Skeleton Warriors have more maximum health, while Skeleton Rogues and Archers deal more damage (all multiplicative with other modifiers). Warrior Maximum Health: +75% Archer Damage: +75% Rogue Damage: +75%

nodes.name: Unbound Necromancy
nodes.text: Summon Skeletons costs less mana, and your Skeletons have improved base critical strike chance. Mana Efficiency: +40% Base Crit Chance: +4%

nodes.name: Unholy Rage
nodes.text: Skeletons have increased attack speed, cast speed, and movement speed. Attack Speed: +28% Cast Speed: +28% Movespeed: +28%

nodes.name: Marrow Walkers
nodes.text: You can summon more Skeletons. Maximum Number Of Skeletons: +1

nodes.name: Hollow Walkers
nodes.text: You can summon more Skeletons. Maximum Number Of Skeletons: +1

nodes.name: Grave Walkers
nodes.text: You can summon more Skeletons. Maximum Number Of Skeletons: +1

nodes.name: Shambling Steel
nodes.text: Skeleton Archers are removed from the pool of Skeletons that can be summoned.

nodes.name: Marrow Tap
nodes.text: Skeletons leech a portion of the damage they deal as health and they have additional physical resistance. Health Leech: +1.5%

nodes.name: Sweeping Strikes
nodes.text: Skeletons have an increased area of effect with melee attacks, and your Skeletons deal more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

nodes.name: Skeleton Rogue
nodes.text: Adds Skeleton Rogues to the pool of Skeletons that can be summoned. Rogues dash to distant enemies, throw shurikens, use melee attacks, and they poison enemies on hit.

nodes.name: Immortal
nodes.text: When a Skeleton dies, there is a chance to summon a random new one at the same location after 3 seconds.

nodes.name: Vile Flask
nodes.text: Skeleton Rogues can now throw a Vile Flask, which inflicts poison and armor shred on hit. Vile Flask has a 5 second cooldown.

nodes.name: Individual Operator
nodes.text: Skeleton Rogues deal more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) for each Skeleton Warrior or Archer you control, up to 5.

nodes.name: Absence of Life
nodes.text: Allies within range are healed by Aura of Decay each second. Heals more the less health you currently have. Percent Of Missing Health Healed: 4%

nodes.name: Plague Bearers
nodes.text: Minions within Aura of Decay's area of effect have a chance to poison on hit, but are poisoned every second. Minion Poison Chance: +100%

nodes.name: Infectious Bones
nodes.text: Minions within Aura of Decay's area of effect deal more poison damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

nodes.name: Inoculation
nodes.text: You take less poison damage while Aura of Decay is active (multiplicative with other modifiers). Poison Damage Taken: -20%

nodes.name: Vulnerability
nodes.text: Enemies within Aura of Decay's area of effect have less Poison Resistance. Enemy Poison Resistance: -15%

nodes.name: Fume Weaver
nodes.text: You and Enemies within Aura of Decay's area of effect have less poison resistance for each point of intelligence you have.

nodes.name: Plague Rat
nodes.text: Aura of Decay affects a larger area. Area: +75%

nodes.name: Respite
nodes.text: You have additional poison resistance while in Aura of Decay and increased health regeneration if you have deactivated it recently. Poison Resistance in Aura of Decay: +15%

nodes.name: Lingering Doom
nodes.text: Dread Shade drains your minions' health more slowly and all affected minions deal additional necrotic damage with spells and attacks.

nodes.name: Wasting Essence
nodes.text: Dread Shade grants affected minions more damage over time (multiplicative with other modifiers). Damage Over Time: 24%

nodes.name: Spectral Distance
nodes.text: Dread Shade has increased area of effect per active minion when cast, up to a maximum benefit.

nodes.name: Vile Ghast
nodes.text: Dread Shade now increases poison damage instead of necrotic damage, and converts added necrotic damage to chance to poison on hit.

nodes.name: Blind Fury
nodes.text: Dread Shade now increases the attack and cast speed of the targeted minion, but they have less critical strike chance.

nodes.name: Dying Coven
nodes.text: Dread Shade grants affected minions increased attack and cast speed. Increased Attack Speed: 24% Increased Cast Speed: 24%

nodes.name: Grim Fate
nodes.text: Dread Shade affects minions in a larger area and grants more damage, but the targeted minion's health decays more quickly.

nodes.name: Spectral Presence
nodes.text: Dread Shade affects minions in a larger area. Area: +50%

nodes.name: Lone Watcher
nodes.text: Dread Shade no longer drains the health of the minion it is attached to, but you are limited to one active Dread Shade.

nodes.name: Bone Armor
nodes.text: When you use Transplant you are granted Bone Armor for 4 seconds, which causes you to take less damage. 10 second cooldown.

nodes.name: Apostasy
nodes.text: Bone Armor lasts longer. Bone Armor Duration (seconds): +3

nodes.name: Marrow Blades
nodes.text: Your minions deal additional melee damage for 4 seconds after you cast Transplant. Minion Melee Damage: +15

nodes.name: Reign of Blood
nodes.text: Transplant creates an additional body that detonates on arrival.

nodes.name: Acolyte's Fervor
nodes.text: Casting Transplant grants you Haste and Frenzy for a short duration.

nodes.name: Sticky Blood
nodes.text: Transplant detonations leave a Pool of Blood for 3 seconds that slows enemies.

nodes.name: Anemia
nodes.text: Transplant costs less health (multiplicative with other modifiers). Health Cost: -32%

nodes.name: Doom Bringer
nodes.text: You cast Bone Curse around the target location after you arrive.

nodes.name: Fleeting Form
nodes.text: Transplant has increased cast speed and cooldown recovery speed. Cast Speed: +15% Cooldown Recovery Speed: +15%

nodes.name: Iron Maiden
nodes.text: Bone Curse deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers). Damage: +50%

nodes.name: Brittle Bones
nodes.text: Bone Curse deals more damage and instantly kills enemies that are below a health threshold.

nodes.name: Acute Infliction
nodes.text: Bone Curse deals more damage, but falls off after a few hits. Damage: +40% Hits Before Fall-off: 4

nodes.name: Conflation
nodes.text: Bone Curse affects a larger area. Area: +90%

nodes.name: Crippling Anguish
nodes.text: Applying Bone Curse to enemies also slows them for a duration. Slow Duration (seconds): 2

nodes.name: Cultist's Fervor
nodes.text: Bone Curse costs less mana and has increased cast speed. Mana Efficiency: +20% Cast Speed: +10%

nodes.name: Merciless
nodes.text: You may cast Bone Curse on your minions, which grants them more physical damage, but also applies Bone Curse's negative effects.

nodes.text: You have additional ward decay threshold. Whenever a nearby enemy, ally, or minion dies, you have a chance to gain ward.

nodes.name: Dark Rituals
nodes.text: Your minions have increased attack and cast speed. Increased Minion Attack Speed: +20% Increased Minion Cast Speed: +20%

nodes.text: Ward Retention: +40% Necrotic Resistance: +20% Poison Resistance: +20%
